prompt:
Create a NEW LEVEL-2 MUSHROOM NEST original game sprite, using the attached level-1 nest ONLY as the established art-style, palette and species reference. This is a finished new source illustration for a 2D game, not a mockup or animation sheet. One centered complete object, square canvas, genuinely transparent RGBA background. Preserve the lovely soft painted coral-red / burgundy mushroom cap, warm ivory flesh, thin dark-teal contour, restrained highlights and slightly elevated front three-quarter camera of the reference.

Design a visibly more mature level-2 nest with absolutely clear, physically coherent structure. Use ONE broad protective mushroom umbrella supported by ONE stout, continuous central ivory stem. The stem sits BEHIND the nursery bowl, visibly connects to the underside of the cap, and runs naturally down into a stable rear base. The cap has a simple flowing convex crown and a continuous softly scalloped burgundy underside; its two side wings stay part of the same cap. No disconnected inner cap pieces, secondary mushrooms, side caps, duplicate stems or floating umbrella.

In FRONT of that stem place a LOW WIDE OVAL IVORY NURSERY BOWL, clearly a separate structure. Its low fleshy front lip and gently thickened double-layer rear collar cradle exactly THREE coral-pink eggs: two at the back and one in front, all resting naturally inside the hollow bowl. Keep the egg cluster clearly visible beneath the canopy. Make the supporting stem and the bowl easy to distinguish: a clean occlusion line at the rear bowl rim, consistent depth and shading, no stem melting into a front petal. The broad cap should shelter the bowl without touching or cutting through the eggs. The stronger stem, roomier cradle and third egg should clearly read as the next growth level while retaining the level-1 species identity.

Make the anatomy simple and intentional enough to separate into a complete canopy attachment, a complete rear stem, a stationary foreground nursery rim and eggs for later animation. Keep all visible contours complete and clean. Generous transparent padding on every edge. No text, labels, frame, contact sheet, comparison, panels, checkerboard, floor, scene, cast shadow outside the asset, faces, eyes, mouth, equipment, plants, decorative tiny mushrooms, overcomplicated flower petals, extra egg-like knobs, fragments, holes, duplicated outlines or transparency inside solid flesh.
